title: Two Worlds. One Mind. From code to intent: a short handbook on building where software meets the physical world
description: A short handbook on systems thinking, AI-assisted work and the point where machines and software meet, with practical checklists, a worked example and a clearly marked speculative essay (Chapter 7). English edition with a German translation.
